title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Serial_220
doc_notes: This is an FBI case file containing correspondence from an inventor regarding theoretical craft designs and clippings of reported UFO sightings in Mexico and Brazil; encounter content is present in the form of reported sightings.

encounters.summary: Student German Horacio Robles Jr. reported observing and photographing a flying saucer over Durango, Mexico, describing it as a double truncated cone moving via jet propulsion.
encounters.quote: seen with their own eyes the flying saucers

encounters.summary: Student Osvaldo Rhodes Jr. reported observing and photographing a flying saucer while a passenger on an airplane over Furnas, describing it as a double truncated cone.
encounters.quote: seen with their own eyes the flying saucers
